sources.excerpt: GOLD Face Germanium - Bad Pixel Pedals Fuzz Overdrive Boost CLASSIC SERIES Custom Videos artwork About Bad Pixel Pedals_Germanium Gold Face This is a luxurious Face. -all point to point wiring [no pcb]. -all USSR high quality, military specs [most] capacitors -all 1/2 watt carbon comp resistors -2x Russian [nos] GT402 Germanium transistors -Push back cloth wire -alpha pots -neutrik jacks -Highest quality -Hand built in Greece Fantastic specimen of point to point wiring. Everything is how it is supposed to be. I like to exaggerate sometimes and this is one of those times. Gold leaf, everything of the highest quality and sonically excellent. It screams, it sustains, it cleans up really nicely. It does it all. It also features an external bias pot. Unique patterns that are taken from my family's transitional hand knit creations. It does take you back to another time. It is special and it is extravagant. It is positive ground so it cannot be daisy chained. It runs with standard negative tip power supply or 9v battery. A rare piece of electronics as there is no board inside, all the components are soldered to one another. It is a very time consuming procedure but it makes the pedal one of a kind. Using the best materials combined with these methods of construction give you the best possible result both sonically and aesthetically. The pedal is covered with gold [not real gold] leaf [no it is not paint] in A RELIC-DISTRESSED fashion the same technique they use in byzantine icon making. It gives it a very unique look. It makes it somehow precious to the eye. Powered by Create your own unique website with customizable templates.
